scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run build && exec python3 -m http.server 3000 --directory dist --bind 0.0.0.0' _
scripts.build: sh -c 'PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pydeps python3 -c "import jinja2" 2>/dev/null || printf "%s\n" "import io,json,platform,sys,urllib.request,zipfile" "from pathlib import Path" "d=Path(\"/tmp/pydeps\"); d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)" "t=f\"cp{sys.version_info.major}{sys.version_info.minor}\"; a=platform.machine()" "for p,v in [(\"MarkupSafe\",\"2.1.5\"),(\"Jinja2\",\"3.1.4\")]:" " urls=[u[\"url\"] for u in json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(f\"https://pypi.org/pypi/{p}/{v}/json\",timeout=10).read())[\"urls\"] if u[\"packagetype\"]==\"bdist_wheel\"]" " u=next((x for x in urls if \"py3-none-any\" in x),None) or next(x for x in urls if t in x and \"manylinux\" in x and a in x)" " zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=15).read())).extractall(d)" | python3 -; PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pydeps python3 build.py'
scripts.lint: sh -c 'PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pydeps python3 -c "import jinja2,pytest" 2>/dev/null || printf "%s\n" "import io,json,platform,sys,urllib.request,zipfile" "from pathlib import Path" "d=Path(\"/tmp/pydeps\"); d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)" "t=f\"cp{sys.version_info.major}{sys.version_info.minor}\"; a=platform.machine()" "for p,v in [(\"MarkupSafe\",\"2.1.5\"),(\"Jinja2\",\"3.1.4\"),(\"iniconfig\",\"\"),(\"packaging\",\"\"),(\"pluggy\",\"\"),(\"pygments\",\"\"),(\"pytest\",\"\")]:" " urls=[u[\"url\"] for u in json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(f\"https://pypi.org/pypi/{p}/{v}/json\" if v else f\"https://pypi.org/pypi/{p}/json\",timeout=10).read())[\"urls\"] if u[\"packagetype\"]==\"bdist_wheel\"]" " u=next((x for x in urls if \"py3-none-any\" in x),None) or next(x for x in urls if t in x and \"manylinux\" in x and a in x)" " zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=15).read())).extractall(d)" | python3 -; PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pydeps:. python3 -m pytest -v'
